ipos.video_evidence: Transcript says the IPO price band is ₹1,700–₹1,785, lot size 8, so one lot at the upper price is ₹14,280. It describes 100% OFS, expected opening 17 Sep 2026, closing 21 Sep 2026, allotment 22 Sep, refunds/shares 23 Sep and listing 24 Sep. The speaker's view is to apply for the long term, while not expecting an unusually high listing gain; the transcript gives a rough 10–20% listing-gain expectation and warns that large IPO supply can pressure listing. These are source opinions, not guarantees.
